difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a left adjoint of a continuous functor is cocontinuous, and that the companion results on the pushforward and pullback apply (statement lines 5136-5148). The proof is a complete argument: given a covering of the image of an object, the author takes its image under the right adjoint, which is a covering by continuity, base changes it along the adjunction map to a covering of the object, and uses the adjunction maps to produce a refinement of the given covering, which is precisely cocontinuity (proof lines 5151-5162); the remaining assertions follow immediately from the two companion results (proof lines 5162-5164). The non-formal content is the base change of the covering and the construction of the refinement. The claim is H2: a written-out verification with each input named.
